description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Tifa)] and [Earth Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Tifa)
description.text: Monk abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Monk abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00 for Monk abilities, critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Monk abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Monk abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Tifa)], removes [Dual Awoken Monk Mode I (Tifa)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Monk Mode II (Tifa)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Monk abilities, critical chance =100%, casts Dual Zangan Blow when removed

description.name: Dual Zangan Blow
description.text: One single attack (8.00) capped at 99999, 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
